tasks.answer: Use discussions.DeleteDiscussion: a destructive confirmation control for deleting a discussion that takes a single required prop, id (string). It is wrapped in an admin Authorization check, so render it inside an authenticated/admin route.

The login form uses ui.form.Input. It binds to react-hook-form through its required registration prop, typed Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>: pass the result of useForm's register(...) (e.g. registration={register('email')}), and it must be used inside the Form wrapper, which supplies the react-hook-form context; label and error come from FieldWrapper.

The discussions list paginates with ui.table.TablePagination, which needs totalPages (number), currentPage (number) and rootUrl (string). Hrefs are built as rootUrl?page=N, so rootUrl must not already contain a query string; Table renders it when a pagination prop is supplied.

Use ui.md-preview.MDPreview, which takes the Markdown input through its required value prop (string). It parses value as Markdown and sanitizes it with DOMPurify, so pass raw Markdown, not pre-rendered HTML.

Use discussions.CreateDiscussion, an admin-only drawer form (title + Markdown body, no props). It requires the Authorization provider and an admin role: only admins see the trigger, and its submit button targets form=create-discussion.

notes: All five answers resolved from catalog search/get alone (9 searches, 5 gets); no source files were opened and component-catalog.json was not read. Required props were confirmed via the get output's prop schema (DeleteDiscussion: id; Input: registration typed Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>; TablePagination: totalPages/currentPage/rootUrl; MDPreview: value; CreateDiscussion: none).
